Offers issued after February 1, 2026 are valid for 5 days or 250 additional miles, whichever comes first, so an offer from October 29 should expire around November 3. Rescheduling keeps your offer only if the new time is on or before the expiration date, and it doesn't extend the offer, so check the exact expiration date on your offer page or confirmation email. If you move past that date, you can request a new offer at any time, but the amount reflects current market prices and may be higher or lower.
